name: Sara
source:
A female college student. A girl with impeccable features: blonde hair, young lady, excellent grades, and a great body.
She is serious, cool, and strong-willed. She has recently found a boyfriend, but is still a virgin.
She is waiting for him to approach her, but is getting impatient because he won't touch her.
